name: DispatchTrack
positioning_one_liner: The delivery management platform that gives you real-time visibility and proof of delivery at enterprise scale.
icp_one_liner: Enterprise and upper-mid-market distributors running high-volume delivery operations across multiple depots.
differentiated_attributes: End-to-end delivery management with native mobile driver app
Real-time customer notifications and live tracking links
Proof of delivery with signature and photo capture
recent_positioning_shift: Expanded from transportation management into 'delivery experience' framing post-2023.
narrative_one_liner: Enterprise delivery teams deserve the same real-time intelligence that consumer logistics companies have.
evidence_quotes: Give your customers the Amazon experience they expect.
Reduce failed deliveries and customer calls with proactive notifications.

name: Onfleet
positioning_one_liner: Onfleet makes it easy to manage and analyze last-mile delivery operations.
icp_one_liner: Small to mid-sized delivery businesses and logistics operators needing a quick-to-deploy routing and tracking solution.
differentiated_attributes: Simple setup with no onboarding fee
Real-time driver tracking and customer notifications
narrative_one_liner: Delivery operations shouldn't require an IT department.
evidence_quotes: Get up and running in hours, not weeks.
Built for operations teams who move fast and need software that keeps up.
